title.rendered: STREAMS OF JOY DEVOTIONAL- MAGNIFIED RESULTS

excerpt.rendered: “Came behind him, and touched the border of his garment: and immediately her issue of blood stanched.” (Luke 8: 44)That is the Focal Scripture of Streams of Joy…

content.rendered: “Came behind him, and touched the border of his garment: and immediately her issue of blood stanched.” (Luke 8: 44)That is the Focal Scripture of Streams of Joy Devotional today.The woman with the issue of blood came to Jesus and touched the hem of His garment. Immediately, her issue of blood disappeared. People around her may have seen her touch Jesus, but in the realm of the Spirit, her touch was more than just a touch; the impact of her touch was more than what should come from a touch; it was a mere touch, but the results were magnified.Friend, hear me as I hear the Lord: your efforts will be magnified. God will cause your little to lead to many; God will cause your little efforts to yield massive results; God will cause your little push to lead to maximum impact; God will cause the little you have done in your career to push you higher; God will cause the efforts you have put into your business to yield mega results; your little will give birth to many.Get set: for every effort you have ever made, God is causing you to have more than your labour could ever afford. God is causing you to achieve more than you worked for; God is causing you to receive more results than you bargained for; God is causing your outputs to greatly and massively outweigh your input; God is causing your touch to birth more than an ordinary touch should birth; God is giving you more than you deserve.If it was a matter of strength, that woman with the issue of blood may not even have touched Jesus, talk more of receiving her healing. Her strength was not enough, and Jesus made things easier for her. In places where your strength is not enough, God will cause things to be made easy for you. In battles you are too small to fight, God will give you resounding victory. In places where your strength is small, you will still prevail.Get set for results that have been divinely magnified; get set to have results that exceed your efforts and input.Isaiah 60: 22 says: “A little one shall become a thousand, and a small one a strong nation: I the LORD will hasten it in his time.”Declare With Me: My efforts are divinely magnified, in Jesus’ name!Follow on Instagram @jerry_ezeFollow on Twitter @jerrystreams
